FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.firstVis: Ohohoho~ A lost child in this Tower? Come here, Mommy will love you always~
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.title: Feixiao
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.1-0r: Has a morsel of [i]food[/i] entered my domain~? Oh, or perhaps you're but another child for [i]my brood~?[/i]
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.2-0r: Come, [i]Oh lost soul[/i], take my blessing and climb~!
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.3-0r: Hello there, come to feed me or deposit a [i]tribute[/i] small one~?
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.4-0r: I could just [i]eat you up[/i], but that will take away my fun, so you can continue for now~
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.5-0r: [i]I miss my wife, Slayer. [b]I miss her a lot.[/b][/i]
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.6-0r: I do wonder, should I reach beyond the boundaries and drag [i]THEM[/i] through to this prison?
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.7-0r: Ugh, I'm full as hell right now, would you do me a favour and... [i]milk me until I'm dry~[/i] You can drink as much as you like.
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.IRONCLAD: Hahahaha~ Cute, you think you can do anything with that? Take this boon and leave, Berserker.
Tell Mommy, she's quite interested in knowing, [i]why do you continue this quest?[/i]
You know the outcome well by now, you face it everytime you meet [i]Him.[/i] Truly, the definition of insanity.
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.SILENT.0: You remind me of a certain Child, she loved her Mommy and stabbing implements.
Ah, what I wouldn't do to hold that child in my arms again~
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.SILENT.1: Tell me, oh silent one, why do [i]you[/i] climb this tower?
Tch, fine, take a boon and continue yonder~
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.SILENT.2: You're a lady correct? Have you considered settling down? if you'd be so kind I'd love to transfer some of the burden of motherhood to you~
Fine~ Be that way, you'll never find the joys of motherhood if you don't try~
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.REGENT.0: My, my, what a pest. Someone who sits on their throne doing nothing but ordering others around.
You dare disrespect the heir to the Throne of Stars, Wench!
Hahahaha~! You speak as if you have any power at all, child. I'll glady swallow you hole, oh arrogant one.
I should smite you where you stand, but I will show you mercy! Offer to me a gift and I will be on my way!
Hmmm, alright, let's see just how far you'll go, Child. Though beware, you're not my equal.
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.REGENT.1: Ah, the morsel of food has come crawling back up?
Oversized sow, I am the future [orange]King[/orange]! You will treat me with the respect my station is [b]due![/b]
Arrogant as ever, little one, careful who to mouth off to, little vermin
If I am a mere vermin to you, then face me!
I'll sooner turn you to fat then I am to fight you, take one of these and leave my domain, before i get [i]snacky~[/i]
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.NECROBIN: Hmmm, Necromancy? My my, such a taboo path, why have you gone down this way, little one?
My reasons aren't your business, ma'am
So be it, but still, take one of these~ I hope they help on whatever it is you're doing here.
Tell me child, why are you crawling up this tower?
Revenge for my family. He will pay for what he's done.
Hmm~ very well, I hope this will be of help. [i][b]Are you certain whatever you're doing is worth it?[/b][/i]
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.DEFECT.0: Hmm, an automaton, tell me Child, are you really [i]alive?[/i]
You have sentience, good, take this and move upward, child of machines.
FEIXIAOMOD-FEIXIAO_ANCIENT.talk.DEFECT.1: Tell me child, who is your creator?
The Architect? Hmm, now that just won't do. Do swing by, Mommy wil give you all the love you're missing out on~
YOu will learn in time, now, do be a dear and go give that deadbeat father of yours a thrashing for me~
